description: Change a Zustand store by name (from get_zustand_state). Merges by default: send only the fields to change, including nested ones ({member:{crowns:5}} keeps member's other fields), and the store's action functions stay. Pass replace:true only to reset the whole store; that drops the store's functions and can break the app.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

replace.description: Default false (merge). true replaces the whole state and deletes the store's action functions.

store.description: Store name to target (from get_zustand_state). Leave out to list the stores.

name: zustand_action
